text:
tess: FYI I pushed an initial "impact_sim" prototype for config rollouts. It runs a simulated routing pass over a traffic snapshot and returns a diff report. Need quick feedback before I wire it into the console.
omid: Nice. Does it simulate quotas/circuit-breakers too or just routing decisions?
tess: Full sim: routing -> quota calc -> prefix/KV cache hits -> candidate fallback selection. We replay a sampled trace against the new config and compare to baseline.
jay: How heavy is the snapshot? We shouldn't block the UI if someone clicks preview on a large customer cohort.
tess: By default we run on a 30m sliding snapshot sampled at 0.5%. There is a tenant-level override for "cohort": you can target a specific org id or tag.
sylvia: Can we get a compact report for the console? Engineers want PASS/FAIL + top 3 regressions rather than raw logs.
tess: Yes. Report shape (short): status (PASS/UNSAFE), safety_metric (0..1), top_deltas: [delta_p95, delta_error_rate, quota_miss_rate], cohort_buckets with small heatmap tokens.
infra-bot: note: impact_sim service currently has a 5s cold-start; consider async + polling for UI.
omid: We should also compute a "route_safety_score" that weights user-impacted cohorts higher. Something like weighted_mean(delta_p95 * cohort_weight). If >0.07 mark UNSAFE.
jay: Agree. Add a tunable fuse in rollout policy. E.g. rollout_policy: {preview_pass_threshold:0.07, auto_abort:true, fallback_target:"stable-v1"}.
sylvia: UX: show a timeline compare slider with baseline vs sim p95, error spikes. Also include a one-click "apply with holdback" to roll to 5% first.
tess: API prototype: POST /internal/configs/impact_sim -> {config, snapshot_window_mins, sample_rate, cohort_filter, compare_to}. Returns {sim_id, status:PENDING}. Poll GET /internal/sim/{sim_id}/report -> report. Example:```
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/configs/impact_sim \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"config":"{...}","snapshot_window_mins":30,"sample_rate":0.005,"compare_to":"stable-v1","cohort_filter":{"tag":"beta"}}'
```
ops-bot: heads-up: we'll need an audit entry when someone runs sim against production snapshots. Add event:config.sim.run with user id + snapshot_id.
omid: Also we must ensure no PII leaks in the sim output—mask user ids and only show hashed cohort ids.
jay: On the policy side: if sim finds quota_miss_rate delta > 0.2 (absolute) for any cohort, rollout must default to fallback_target and create a pager ticket.
sylvia: For the console workflow: button order: "Run impact sim" -> show quick summary card -> "Compare" opens expanded. If PASS, show suggested rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-monitoring gates.
tess: I'll add a monotonic metric config.sim.safety_score and config.sim.duration_ms. We'll export exception counts and cohort_skew ratio.
omid: Can we add a "replay_id" in the report so teams can re-run exact same sim later? Also store reports for 30 days in the audit bucket.
tess: Yes. report will include replay_id and snapshot_id. Stored reports expire after 30 days, can be exported.
infra-bot: deploy note: impact_sim service will be rolled out to staging first; ETA tomorrow 03:30 UTC.
jay: Final q: who can run sims? Everyone or only members of a config-owner group? We should restrict sim-to-production-snapshot to a small group.
sylvia: Restrict by default. Add RBAC: sim.run:production requires "config-sim" role. UI will hide the button if unauthorized.
tess: Great catch. I'll open PR that includes API, console mocks, and rollout policy changes. Tagging @ops-team for the RBAC + audit changes. Thanks all. :sparkles:
